recorded_human_direction.decision: PostgreSQL is the final production authority; .greenagent is a temporary development tool and will be retired.
PostgreSQL is required in production and SQLite is limited to single-user local use.
Provide a global Inbox where humans and agents can chat without requiring project attachment.
Use maize as the first reference workflow while keeping the initial breeding schema generic with versioned JSONB or extension fields.
Learn-stage output enters Project Working Memory and requires human approval before promotion to Validated Project Knowledge.

decisions_deferred_to_builder_proposal: Workspace security boundary and global Inbox participation policy.
Generic breeding records and maize-v1 extension profile.
Private-owner visibility and sharing policy for migrated legacy threads.
Agent write authority and additional human DBTL gates.
Validated-knowledge promotion authority and evidence requirements.
Reconciliation retry limits, alerts, and recovery authority.
notes: The human explicitly approved the complete integrated design and authorized Designer-to-Builder handoff. Remaining detailed choices are Builder proposals constrained by the approved design and retain their applicable human review gates.
